findings.description: Direct inspection of all five V189 views and all six pose renders: the pleated skirt still has severe faceting and irregular folds. Crouch shows only a partial front-lap over the raised leg; large anterior thigh/knee surfaces remain uncovered. In sit, the apron still hangs behind and between the thighs and broad front-thigh surfaces remain exposed.

The V189 front and side views still show angular planar shading across the bodice and a gray waist-area patch of unverified surface ownership. The waist/back construction remains stiff and visibly irregular. Bodice appearance is unacceptable.

Current source-bound component-ID renders from weighted mesh SHA-256 ad9b7d92727b40d85348584c827040247f392e1c6d28bbd5db06267b3d54e160: crouch shows 7638 shorts-only and 4616 front-lap pixels (V188 7471/2697); sit shows 9387 shorts-only and 5815 front-lap pixels (V188 9121/5333). Unique same-pose front-thigh ray hits are 48/532 in crouch (V188 23/532) and 20/532 in sit (V188 20/532). The crouch projection improves, but direct renders still show substantial uncovered thigh; seated coverage is unchanged. Projected pixels and geometric rays are diagnostics, not fit evidence.

nextAction: Do not increase hem length or neutral-surface blend again. Replace the neutral-body placement response with a bounded pose-space thigh envelope mapped back to the authored front-lap panels; preserve exact canonical hem/seam boundaries and 2D bounds. Then evaluate the same weighted-mesh crouch/sit coverage directly. Separately retain the blocking skirt-fold and bodice-surface findings, plus the existing fit, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release gates.
